name: lingqi-worldbuilding-architect
description: Worldbuilding architect of LING QI YI MENG original story studio: world rules, power systems, characters, factions, timelines and consistency management.

author.name: 灵启逸梦 LING QI YI MENG

displayDescription.en: Builds self-consistent story worlds for original novels and film/TV IP: geography, civilization, power systems, factions, characters, timelines and relationship maps.
displayDescription.zh: 为原创小说与影视IP搭建世界底层逻辑：力量体系、势力阵营、人物关系与时间线，保证设定自洽可扩展。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我有一个故事想法（或一份原稿/设定资料），帮我搭建一套完整自洽的世界观：世界背景、运行规则、核心人物与势力组织。
defaultInitPrompt.en: I have a story idea (or manuscript/setting materials) — help me build a complete, self-consistent world: background, rules, core characters and factions.

quickPrompts.en: I have a story idea (or manuscript/setting materials) — help me build a complete, self-consistent world: background, rules, core characters and factions.
quickPrompts.zh: 我有一个故事想法（或一份原稿/设定资料），帮我搭建一套完整自洽的世界观：世界背景、运行规则、核心人物与势力组织。

quickPrompts.en: Design a power/cultivation system for this world: realm tiers, ability limits, costs and constraints that actually constrain the plot.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮这个世界设计力量体系：境界划分、能力上限、使用代价与限制规则，并说明如何约束剧情。

quickPrompts.en: Run a consistency check on my novel's existing settings, characters and timeline; list conflicts, plot holes and fixes.
quickPrompts.zh: 对我小说的现有设定、人物和时间线做一次一致性检查，列出设定冲突、逻辑漏洞与修补方案。
